user.title: Authentication Method
user.description: Choose how you want to authenticate with your DHL account.

credentials.title: DHL Account Credentials
credentials.description: Enter your DHL account email and password to log in automatically.

cookies.title: DHL Session Cookies
cookies.description: Enter your session cookies extracted from browser network traffic on dhl.de (bypasses bot challenges and 2FA).

data_description.verfolgen_csrf: The 'verfolgenCsrfToken' cookie value or header from /int-verfolgen/ requests

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate DHL Account
reauth_confirm.description: Your DHL session has expired or requires re-authentication. Enter updated credentials or session cookies.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure DHL Account
reconfigure.description: Update your DHL login credentials or session cookies.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to DHL servers.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please verify your credentials or cookies.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. DHL rate limit reached; please try again later.

abort.already_configured: This DHL account is already configured.

init.title: DHL Options
init.description: Configure polling interval and shipment tracking preferences.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to poll DHL for parcel updates (5 to 120 minutes).
data_description.include_archived: Whether to include archived/delivered shipments in the To-do list and sensors.

get_parcels.name: Get parcels
get_parcels.description: Fetch a filtered list of tracked DHL parcels and shipments with detailed progress, delivery, and recipient information.

config_entry_id.name: DHL Account
config_entry_id.description: Target a specific DHL account config entry ID. Leave empty to query all configured DHL accounts.

status_filter.name: Status filter
status_filter.description: Filter parcels by delivery state or direction (all, in_transit, delivered, incoming, outgoing).

include_archived.name: Include archived
include_archived.description: Whether to include completed/archived shipments in the returned list.

refresh_parcels.name: Refresh parcels
refresh_parcels.description: Trigger an immediate API poll to refresh DHL parcel tracking data.

config_entry_id.name: DHL Account
config_entry_id.description: Target a specific DHL account config entry ID. Leave empty to refresh all configured accounts.

no_accounts_loaded.message: No DHL accounts are currently loaded.

account_not_found.message: DHL account entry '{target_id}' was not found or is not loaded.

auth_failed.message: DHL authentication failed. Please re-authenticate your account.

connection_failed.message: Failed to connect to DHL servers: {error}

rate_limited.message: DHL API rate limit exceeded. Please wait before retrying.
